messages:
Anika: Huge thanks to @Devon, @Cheng and the infra crew for jumping on the Dedicated cluster OOM last night — demo is back online and I owe you all coffee ☕️ :sparkles:
Devon: no problem! we bumped the KV cache and shipped a tiny hotfix, nothing heroic, just sleep-deprived teamwork :sleeping:
Cheng: happy it worked. shoutout to @sre-oncall for the quick alerts — made the triage way smoother :tada:
Marcus: massive :thumbsup: from me. you folks are why rollouts feel less scary. virtual donuts incoming 🍩
Lina: extra kudos for the clear post-mortem notes, btw. saved me from a 9am panic when I saw alerts. added a few followups to the infra board ✅
reminder-bot: Heads up — if folks want real donuts/coffee for the late-night crew, file a People Ops snack request in #people-ops by Friday EOD.
Anika: Also, demo swag (stickers + a couple of tees) survived the chaos — available in conf room C, help yourselves :grin:
Devon: i'll take a sticker pack and maybe a tee if medium is left :sweat_smile:
Ethan: Kudos karma time — awarding 10 Kudos points to Devon and Cheng. Team tag: #rescue-squad 🙌
Lina: love seeing cross-team help like this. thanks again everyone — means a lot 💚
